Bihar BSSC Stenographer 2025 Online Correction Form 2026 – Full Details

Bihar Staff Selection Commission (BSSC) has released the Correction / Edit Form for the post of Stenographer. This recruitment has been issued for 432 posts. Online applying process for BSSC Stenographer Recruitment 2025 were accepted from 25 September 2025 to 21 November 2025. Candidates must check the complete details for BSSC Stenographer Online Correction Form 2026 which has given below.

Important Dates

  • Notification Date : 20 August 2025
  • Application Start Date : 25 September 2025
  • Last Date : 21 November 2025
  • Fee Payment Last Date : 21 November 2025
  • Las Date for Final Submit Form : 24 November 2025
  • Correction / Edit Form : 25 – 31 October 2026
  • Exam Date : Notify Later
  • Admit Card : Before Exam

Application Fee

  • All Candidates : Rs. 100/-

How to Apply Online

  1. Click on the direct Apply Online link in the Important Links section below.
  2. Complete new registration with your Name, Email, and Mobile Number.
  3. Fill the application form with personal, educational, and address details.
  4. Upload scanned photograph, signature, and required certificates.
  5. Pay the applicable examination fee online and download the submission receipt.
